Snapshot identity is issued only for a fully checksummed, sealed producer
workspace. Missing identity disables archive reuse, not synchronization.

Diagnostics, not additive phases. Build wall time includes SSH admission;
a reused caller's acquisition wait may overlap that same shared build.

artifactBuildRef.description:
ArtifactBuildRef identifies an immutable, server-created build
specification. Authored workflows never contain browser/host paths.

image.description:
Image is the legacy shorthand for an OCI reference or a destination path.
New definitions should use Executable. It is kept so existing workflow
definitions remain valid while the planner resolves them.
